probes.name: archive-export-v2
probes.reason: v2 export completes and reports the exported entity total; the archive blob is captured for downstream probes

probes.name: archive-export-cancel
probes.reason: cancel-export aborts the in-flight v2 export and surfaces cancellation guidance

probes.name: archive-import-preview
probes.reason: import previews the validated archive (format v2, record count) with explicit confirm/cancel controls — nothing written yet

probes.name: archive-import-cancel
probes.reason: cancel-import closes the preview without writes and restores focus to the Import trigger; no result is reported

probes.name: archive-import-collision
probes.reason: non-identical ID collision (mutated content, valid digest) is reported in the preview before any write — never overwrites

probes.name: archive-import-success
probes.status: Imported 0 records — 23 reused ("success-v2.json") | Exported complete v2 archive — 23 entities.
probes.reason: confirming the identical-reuse preview commits atomically and reports 'Imported N records — M reused' (idempotent reuse, no writes)

probes.name: archive-secret-no-echo
probes.alerts: The archive is invalid — nothing was imported. payload: prohibited credential/transport key in tasks
probes.reason: archive carrying a prohibited credential key is rejected with a classified error that never echoes the secret-shaped value; no preview is offered

probes.name: catalog-empty-state
probes.reason: fresh empty workbench renders the explicit empty-catalog state ('No tasks yet.') with a New task action and no horizontal overflow

probes.name: catalog-migration-error-state
probes.reason: deterministic migration-error surfaces the classified load/error state (alert role, Retry action, unavailable text) and never echoes secret-shaped content

probes.name: catalog-migration-error-state-verdict
probes.reason: classified migration-error state renders with alert role + Retry + unavailable/failed text, no secret echo
